packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch updates to Cargo dependencies and the pinned Rust toolchain (rust-toolchain.toml) after required CI checks pass.

GitHub Actions are pinned to commit SHAs; auto-merge digest updates, which stay on the same major/minor tag (the trailing comment shows the tag). Digest updates do not reliably carry a release timestamp, so the global minimumReleaseAge would keep them pending forever; skip it (CI validates the change).
Our own image is rebuilt on every push to main, so a new digest appears faster than the stability window; skip minimumReleaseAge for it (it is already validated by CI).
Require human review for potentially breaking dependency updates.
